notes: This patch restores the reviewed JDK 21 result-use obligations to the native bundle for the existing ignored-status-result and discarded-transformation policies. It adds an explicit authored job for bifrost.jdk21.result-use-obligations 1.0.0. Its schema-5 envelope migrates to version-independent schema 8; only the schema label and engine-version gate change, preserving reviewed summaries, IDs, JDK 21 activation, provenance, license and completeness. The seven batch-10 result-use models and Python String are already present in packs 0.6.0 and remain selected unchanged. Producer pins and all other jobs and recipes are unchanged. Generated schema requirements remain 8 and 17. Generation, integrity, compatibility and per-run completeness remain separate from behavior qualification; Files.deleteIfExists retains its partial summary. Rules 0.5.2 is needed for normal acquisition to select this pack release instead of the exact 0.6.0 dependency in rules 0.5.1.
